findings.summary: The paper asserts invertibility of H throughout each enlarged slow neighborhood and positivity only on its intersection with the shell. Lean asserts the determinant gap and the positive weights on the same, smaller set: the closed active annulus at positive times intersected with the cell carrier.

No single declaration states Proposition 7.5. Clauses (iii)–(vi) exist only as general theorems whose hypotheses the actual construction's certificates meet; conjoining them for the actual $y_\sigma,a_\sigma,W_0$ is pure instantiation, not mathematics.

The actual form of (7.26) carries the squared slow cutoff: Lean's pair covariance equals $\varepsilon\,\eta_\beta^2\,\mathcal{T}_{0,*}$, where the paper states $\mathcal{C}(W_0)=\varepsilon\mathcal{T}_{0,*}$ before multiplication by the cutoff.
